name: BODY-LEAN-upright-quad
old: const qUp = up ?? (flat ? WORLD_UP : pictureUp(camDir));   // AUDIT OW4 J6: the quad's vertical
new: const qUp = up ?? WORLD_UP;   // AUDIT OW4 J6: the quad's vertical
note: The report back: the picture taken down the pitched ray pasted upright - every body and 3D horse cos(pitch) of its height, shrinking as the camera rises over it.

name: BODY-LEAN-lone-pass-upright
old: hitFlash, conceal, qUp, null, fx, depth);
new: hitFlash, conceal, up, null, fx, depth);
note: The lone pass (a figure drawn with no batch open) draws its quad upright while its anchor was landed along the lean: the figure shrinks and slides off its feet.

name: BODY-LEAN-batch-upright
old: quad: { at, halfW, halfH, right, hitFlash, conceal, up: qUp, fx, depth } });
new: quad: { at, halfW, halfH, right, hitFlash, conceal, up, fx, depth } });
note: The batch (MWNPC2 - every body of a frame) draws its quads upright: the report on every body and horse in the world.

name: BODY-LEAN-leans-toward-the-eye
old: return [-nx * ny / hl, hl, -nz * ny / hl];
new: return [nx * ny / hl, hl, nz * ny / hl];
note: The lean the wrong way - toward an eye above: foreshortened as badly as upright, and the other way.
